interface.signature: def maxCandies(status: List[int], candies: List[int], keys: List[List[int]], containedBoxes: List[List[int]], initialBoxes: List[int]) -> int:

preconditions.expression: len(status) == len(candies) == len(keys) == len(containedBoxes) and 1 <= len(status) <= 1000
preconditions.description: All input lists have the same length n, where 1 ≤ n ≤ 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(status[i] in {0, 1} for i in range(len(status)))
all(1 <= candies[i] <= 1000 for i in range(len(candies)))
preconditions.description: Each candies[i] is an integer between 1 and 1000 (inclusive).

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= len(keys[i]) <= len(status) and all(0 <= keys[i][j] < len(status) for j in range(len(keys[i]))) and len(set(keys[i])) == len(keys[i]) for i in range(len(keys)))
preconditions.description: Each keys[i] is a list of unique box indices (0 ≤ keys[i][j] < n), with no duplicates.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= len(containedBoxes[i]) <= len(status) and all(0 <= containedBoxes[i][j] < len(status) for j in range(len(containedBoxes[i]))) and len(set(containedBoxes[i])) == len(containedBoxes[i]) for i in range(len(containedBoxes)))
preconditions.description: Each containedBoxes[i] is a list of unique box indices (0 ≤ containedBoxes[i][j] < n), with no duplicates.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= initialBoxes[i] < len(status) for i in range(len(initialBoxes)))
preconditions.description: Each initialBoxes[i] is a valid box index (0 ≤ initialBoxes[i] < n).

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(candies[i] for i in accessible_boxes) and accessible_boxes == set(collectible_boxes(status, candies, keys, containedBoxes, initialBoxes))
postconditions.description: The function returns the sum of candies in all boxes that can be accessed starting from initialBoxes, where accessible_boxes is the set of all boxes that can be opened following the rules (open if status is 1 or a key is obtained, and recursively for contained boxes).

postconditions.expression: all(box in accessible_boxes for box in initialBoxes if status[box] == 1)
postconditions.description: All boxes in initialBoxes with status 1 are included in accessible_boxes.

postconditions.expression: all(box in accessible_boxes for box in containedBoxes[box_idx] if box_idx in accessible_boxes and status[box_idx] == 1)
postconditions.description: If a box box_idx is accessible and open (status[box_idx] == 1), all boxes contained in it (containedBoxes[box_idx]) are also accessible.

postconditions.expression: all(box in accessible_boxes for box in keys[box_idx] if box_idx in accessible_boxes and status[box_idx] == 1)
postconditions.description: If a box box_idx is accessible and open (status[box_idx] == 1), all boxes that can be opened with its keys (keys[box_idx]) are also accessible.

postconditions.expression: not any(box in accessible_boxes for box in initialBoxes if status[box] == 0)
postconditions.description: No closed box in initialBoxes is included in accessible_boxes unless a key to open it is obtained from another accessible box.
